decisions.reason: As a recently launched handle family that is already shown on the website, it carries fresh development investment and enough public commitment that management is likely to continue backing it rather than withdraw it quickly.
The mitred door lever handle family is a new 2023 launch and, despite no reported success yet, management would likely justify its recent investment by keeping it on the market for longer.

Because the multifunctional door lever handle is a newer and potentially more niche variant without visible market proof yet, its risk of withdrawal is somewhat higher, but escalation of commitment still points to retaining it for now.
This newly introduced door lever handle fits the firm’s core range, so the combination of sunk launch costs and strategic fit makes a near-term withdrawal unlikely.
The new door and window handle collection has its own page and a German Design Award, creating strong public commitment and reputational reasons for management to keep it on the market.
The light patinated bronze finish is only recently introduced and likely inexpensive to continue offering, so management would tend to keep it unless weak demand becomes unmistakable.
